summary: Before running the program, emit runs the typecheck tool the program declares with its project, refusing on a type error or on no declaration
acceptance: emit over a program with a type error refuses naming the compiler's diagnostics; a program declaring no typecheck refuses naming the declaration; the project file is a declared input
tests: emit refuses a program whose typecheck reports a type error
emit refuses a program that declares no typecheck
the typecheck project file is a declared input
notes: 0098 as amended by 0100/0104: the typecheck is a tool reference; command-reference-declaration (in git) held it. Never resolves the compiler by guess. Every emitting fixture gains a declaration via the shared helper. The dogfood `.temper/` must declare one (human) or its emit refuses — name it in the commit body.
